tagline: An adaptive Algebra I mastery world in the browser.

waves.name: Direction
waves.note: The bibles everything else is judged against.

waves.name: World
waves.note: Terrain, sky, light, materials, post, scatter, VFX.

waves.name: Learning
waves.note: KaTeX, knowledge graph, mastery, items, teaching, verbs, i18n.

waves.name: Interface
waves.note: HUD, menus, onboarding, progress, audio, building.

pieces.title: World bible & narrative voice
pieces.judge: Tone blend is unmistakable and original; a stranger can retell the premise after one read.

pieces.title: Art direction bible
pieces.judge: Blind A/B against reference/brief-hero.png names concrete, reproducible rules.

pieces.title: Learning architecture & knowledge graph
pieces.judge: Acyclic prerequisite DAG, every node standards-tagged, mastery math specified with numbers.

pieces.title: Character controller & movement feel
pieces.judge: Weight, momentum, coyote time, buffered input; measured curves, not vibes.

pieces.title: Third-person camera rig
pieces.judge: Framing holds under speed and collision; never clips, never fights the player.

pieces.title: Traversal kit — mantle, climb, glide, dash
pieces.judge: The horizon becomes reachable; each verb has commitment and recovery.

pieces.title: Input — keyboard, mouse, gamepad, rebinding
pieces.judge: Whole game playable on a pad; deadzones and buffering feel console-grade.

pieces.title: Avatar — mesh, rig, procedural animation
pieces.judge: Silhouette reads at thumbnail size; run cycle and landings sell the weight.

pieces.title: Level 1 island — terrain & composition
pieces.judge: Sightlines pose questions; landmarks pull; no dead space.

pieces.title: Sky, aurora, atmosphere
pieces.judge: Sky does real work in the frame; aurora is alive, not wallpaper.

pieces.title: Lighting rig & material language
pieces.judge: Warm rock vs cool resonance; contact shadows ground everything; materials read as substances.

pieces.title: Post-processing stack
pieces.judge: Bloom, grade and vignette serve legibility; scales down cleanly on low tiers.

pieces.title: Scatter — crystal, flora, debris, instancing
pieces.judge: Density without noise; instanced within the draw budget.

pieces.title: VFX system
pieces.judge: Every verb has a read; nothing is a white sprite.

pieces.title: Strict KaTeX pipeline — DOM and in-world
pieces.judge: Zero failures, zero raw TeX, crisp at 4K, legible in 3D at distance.

pieces.title: Mastery engine — graph runtime, ability, spacing
pieces.judge: Simulated median learner reaches 80%+; a guessing bot does not.

pieces.title: Item bank & generators — Algebra I Level 1
pieces.judge: Every item tagged, arithmetic-audited, distractors map to real misconceptions.

pieces.title: Invisible explicit teaching director
pieces.judge: Worked example → faded scaffold → independent, with nothing announced as a lesson.

pieces.title: In-world learning verbs
pieces.judge: A critic describes what they did with their hands, and it was algebra.

pieces.title: Localization EN / ES / PL
pieces.judge: Real localization including math convention; zero missing keys; no layout breakage.

pieces.title: HUD
pieces.judge: Console-grade: readable at a glance, silent when it should be.

pieces.title: Menus, settings, accessibility
pieces.judge: Full pad navigation, real accessibility options that actually change the render.

pieces.title: Title screen & first five minutes
pieces.judge: Teaches controls and premise without a tutorial voice; the hook lands.

pieces.title: Mastery & progress visualization
pieces.judge: A learner sees exactly what they know, in-world and honestly.

pieces.title: Audio director
pieces.judge: Adaptive score and diegetic SFX generated in-engine; mix survives chaos.

pieces.title: Construction system
pieces.judge: Fortnite-fast: verb resolves in a few frames, result legible instantly, ties to the math.

pieces.title: Session, save, and the Level 1 delivery pipeline
pieces.judge: A full Level 1 run start to finish, resumable, ending above 80% mastery.

pieces.title: Coherence & performance pass
pieces.judge: One coherent thing: shared vocabulary, shared timing, no seams; frame budget met.

pieces.title: Build & delivery
pieces.judge: Production build boots from a static host with zero errors in all three locales.
